title: Vegetarian Cheese and Bean Enchiladas Verde
summary: Soft tortillas filled with spiced black beans and cheddar, covered in tangy green salsa and baked until bubbling. A comforting Mexican-inspired vegetarian dinner for busy weeknights.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Lightly spread about one quarter of the green salsa over the base of a medium baking dish.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5–6 minutes, stirring often, until soft and translucent.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli powder. Cook for 1 minute, stirring, until fragrant.
Stir in the black beans, sweetcorn, salt and black pepper. Cook for 4–5 minutes until hot, then lightly mash some of the beans with the back of a spoon so the filling holds together.

Warm the corn tortillas briefly in a dry pan or microwave until pliable. Fill each tortilla with the bean mixture and a small handful of grated cheddar, reserving about one third of the cheese for the top.
Roll up the tortillas and place them seam-side down in the baking dish. Pour the remaining green salsa over the top and scatter with the reserved cheddar.
Bake for 18–22 minutes, until the cheese is melted and golden in spots and the salsa is bubbling around the edges.
Let the enchiladas rest for 5 minutes, then serve with sour cream, chopped coriander and lime wedges.
